settings.installation_convention: Fixed +90deg mapping; CAD J2 +X axis maps to world +Y, positive J2 tilts upper arm toward world +X. No base search.
settings.tool_connection: S50-only compact 105mm open rigid mount to the original backplate. Original long bracket bodies 11/12/13 and 200mm extension removed; source front openings retained in three shortened mounting parts. Flange to compressed cup contact is 172.5mm. FANUC keeps its inherited connector.
